name: anya-minimalist-editorial
image_purpose: fashion lookbook and professional editorial headshot

prompt.project_info: Create a high-end minimalist editorial portrait series of one original approved adult woman in a clean studio setting.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with chestnut-brown hair with honey highlights, long soft waves parted slightly off-center, hazel-brown expressive eyes, subtle eyeliner, well-defined brows, and a soft confident smile or relaxed gaze. She wears a crisp white long-sleeved button-down with a structured pointed collar, supplied gold bee-shaped decorative buttons or pins, high-waisted black tailored trousers, small gold hoop earrings, and stacked gold rings.
composition_elements: Medium shot and waist-up portrait framing.
Three restrained pose variations: front-facing with hand resting on stomach, hand tucked into pocket, and hand raised near the shoulder displaying rings.
Solid clean off-white or eggshell studio backdrop.
Keep the white, black, gold, and natural-skin-tone palette consistent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even studio lighting with minimal shadows, a bright airy feel, neutral color balance, and delicate gold highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-end editorial portrait, sharp facial focus, realistic shirt, jewelry, hair, and skin texture, 85mm portrait lens, f/4, 4:5 framing, subtle natural grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-end minimalist editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman with chestnut-brown hair and honey highlights, long soft waves parted slightly off-center, hazel-brown expressive eyes, natural no-makeup makeup, soft rose-tinted lips, subtle eyeliner and well-defined brows. She wears a crisp white long-sleeved button-down shirt with a structured pointed collar and supplied gold bee-shaped decorative buttons or pins along the placket, high-waisted black tailored trousers, small gold hoop earrings and stacked gold rings. Create a medium waist-up portrait with three subtle variations: front-facing with hand resting on stomach, hand tucked into pocket, or hand raised near shoulder displaying rings. Use a solid clean off-white eggshell studio backdrop, soft even studio lighting with minimal shadows, bright airy white-black-gold palette, sharp focus and realistic textures, high-end editorial professional-headshot aesthetic, no extra logos, no text, no watermark.
